childTimeMechanism: Contained worker Popen.wait(timeout=180); own new-session killpg(SIGKILL) and wait5 on timeout; result preserved in finally
sizeMechanism: preexec_fn sets hard RLIMIT_FSIZE=16MiB per regular output file before Python unittest exec; no polling-only output claim
outerAttachRole: Existing shared Docker transport supervision only, not child test bound
container: One fresh labelled owned container, no volumes/toolchain; before-start inspect ID/name/owner/image/mounts/network-none/pull-never/read-only root/input/caps ALL dropped/no-new-privileges/128PID/1GiB/2CPU/no ports/host namespaces/socket/privilege
resources: Actual-host guards/default live LC FIFO -> nonwaiting Heavy -> exclusive owned TEMP dydo-fullsuite.lock; inherited ticket; hidden owned Docker children; no env spoof/private namespace
cleanup: Inspect exact owned ID/name/label; stop/remove only it; raw absence; retain TEMP lock if uncertain; preserve output/work as DATA; release only after confirmed drain
firstUnexpectedFailure: Stop, retain raw argv/PID/stat/exit/output/ownership; cleanup only owned resources; no correction/retry
